title: Synchronize shell TLAS rebuilds with timeline semaphores and barriers
purpose: Prevent races between shell extraction, BLAS builds, TLAS updates and mesh rendering that can cause crashes or stale bindings.

steps.detail: Create a VkSemaphore (timeline) dedicated to RT builds; track a monotonically increasing counter (buildCounter).
After marching cubes completes and vertex/index uploads finish (transfer→device), signal buildCounter=N.
Submit BLAS builds waiting on timeline value N; upon completion signal N+1. Use vkCmdPipelineBarrier2 for buffer availability (HOST/TRANSFER→AS_BUILD_READ).
Submit TLAS build waiting on N+1; signal N+2 when done.
In mesh render pass, wait on timeline value N+2 before binding shell TLAS. Guard with a frame-local cached value to avoid stalls when no rebuild occurred.

acceptance: No crashes during periodic shell rebuilds
Shell TLAS device address logged each rebuild; render pass prints the timeline value it waited for
No validation errors related to hazards
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('Synchronization2 pipeline barriers for AS build inputs')
notes: Signal only when GPU-side operations finish (queue submission), not on CPU finish. Consider batching BLAS builds for multiple shells into one submit.
